are_you_ok.title: PSC approves reduced Mon Power rate increase
are_you_ok.summary: West Virginia's Public Service Commission (the state utility regulator) approved a rate increase for Mon Power, an electric utility, though the increase was smaller than what the company had sought. you_should_know.title: Trump approves West Virginia’s $4.5 million disaster declaration request in Upshur, Lewis counties
you_should_know.summary: This thread follows the flood recovery in Lewis and Upshur counties (rural north-central West Virginia) after a July 21 flood. It began with a large community fundraising push, in which thousands of people, along with local media company WVRC Media, a roofing firm, and Huntington Bank, teamed up to help meet victims' needs. As recovery continued, officials tallied the toll: 48 homes destroyed and nearly 200 homes with major damage. The arc culminated in federal help, as President Trump approved West Virginia's request for a $4.5 million disaster declaration covering Upshur and Lewis counties, with FEMA still weighing similar requests for five other counties.
you_should_know.description: FEMA is also evaluating disaster declaration requests in five other counties. The post Trump approves West Virginia’s $4.5 million disaster declaration request in Upshur, Lewis counties appeared first on WV MetroNews.

you_should_know.title: GOP disavows Pritt from party and candidacy
you_should_know.summary: West Virginia's state Republican Party took what was described as an unprecedented step, voting on a Saturday to remove Pritt as a party member and disavow the candidacy. State GOP chair Holstein publicly backed the move, saying the evidence made it the only choice. With Pritt out, Republicans in Fayette County (a county in southern West Virginia) then named candidates to fill the unexpired term for the 50th House district seat, which is set to expire during the year.
